_about: Vladimir Sergeyevich Solovyov (1853-1900), Russian philosopher: War and Christianity from the Russian Point of View: Three Conversations, with an introduction by Stephen Graham (London: Constable, first published July 1915; this copy the October 1915 reprint), raw IA OCR, clean 0.93. Graham's preface credits Edward Cazalet with Conversation II and W. J. Barnes and H. H. Haynes with Conversation III; it names no translator for Conversation I. US public domain. Added in round 2026-10-17bg: The Justification of the Good, an essay on moral philosophy, tr. Nathalie A. Duddington (London: Constable, 1918), raw IA OCR, clean 0.95. No uids minted.
